select a.* from article a left join article_category_relation acr on a.id = acr.article_id left join user u on a.user_id = u.id
and acr.category_id = #{categoryId} and a.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and a.create_time > #{createTime} and u.nickname like concat('%', #{userNickname}, '%')
order by a.create_time desc
